Cold Exhaust Courier.name: Cold Exhaust Courier
Cold Exhaust Courier.description: The user receives external cooling across both exhaust assemblies, secures one passenger and drives at maximum output along several kilometers of open roadway in under a minute. Carefully timed throttle changes keep the passenger held through planned bends and the final braking run. Cooling must be supplied by an ally or equipment; this Quirk produces none. Obstacles force an abort, and afterward the engines stall for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.
